ValidationRule.description: R-RC1 and ADR-0010: a receipt's number, type, statement year, donor, amount, issue date and stored file do not change once the record exists. A correction is a void plus a new receipt. The stored file identifier is written once, immediately after the document is stored, and is immutable from then on: it starts empty because the file does not exist until the record it is linked to does.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISCHANGED(Receipt_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Type__c), ISCHANGED(Statement_Year__c), ISCHANGED(Donor_Contact__c), ISCHANGED(Donor_Account__c), ISCHANGED(Gift__c), ISCHANGED(Total_Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Issue_Date__c), AND( ISCHANGED(Content_Document_Id__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Content_Document_Id__c))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A receipt cannot be changed once it exists. Void it and issue a new one instead.
